section_locator: Q2 2026 Operational Highlights - Lake Mariner & Form 10-Q Note 8
exact_quote: TeraWulf reported 102 MW of operational infrastructure at Lake Mariner by July 2026, with an additional 336 MW under active construction across CB-4 (expected phase-in H2 2026) and CB-5 (early 2027), while pursuing an incremental 250 MW of power subject to large-load interconnection approval.
